blocks.heading: THE PART BETWEEN A SCREEN RECORDING AND A SHAREABLE CLIP
blocks.body:
QuickClipper is a focused desktop clip editor for the repetitive work that happens after capturing a screen recording: choose the useful region, set in and out points, crop or resize the frame, keep the export under a file-size target, and get the result out quickly. The interface keeps the source pool, viewer, inspector and timeline visible at once so a small edit does not grow into a full editing session.

The current app is built with Tauri and React. It produces Windows installers, supports signed GitHub releases and updates, and includes video, audio and audio-only export paths.
